interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe, continuous path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at intersections to improve visibility and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections or potential crossing points to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Regular clearing of debris and leaves to ensure a clear, non-slip walking surface and to reveal any underlying pavement defects.

interventions.title: Intersection Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs or other appropriate traffic control devices to clarify right-of-way at the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety along the isolated vacant lot frontage.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to create a physical buffer from the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to designate safe crossing locations.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures like speed humps to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this institutional/residential context.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk's material, color, and grade across the driveway to signal pedestrian priority to drivers.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the curb cut to the minimum required for safe vehicle entry, shortening the pedestrian exposure distance.

interventions.title: Tactile Warning Strips
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces at the transition between the sidewalk and the driveway to assist visually impaired pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, separated path for all users.

interventions.title: Streetscape Landscaping
interventions.description: Incorporate street trees or a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Bypass
interventions.description: Provide a protected, ADA-compliant temporary walkway using barriers to maintain pedestrian access around the construction site.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or raised tables to slow vehicle speeds on this narrow, residential-adjacent block.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes are high, a marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage and potentially a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB) could be installed.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions/Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at the nearest intersections to improve visibility and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Walkway
interventions.description: Provide a protected, ADA-compliant temporary walkway to ensure safe passage around the construction site.

interventions.title: Temporary Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting along the construction hoarding to improve safety and visibility for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes warrant, install a marked midblock crossing with high-visibility markings to provide a designated space for crossing the street.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point in this institutional area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Detour Signage
interventions.description: Install clear signage at the nearest intersections to inform pedestrians of the sidewalk closure and direct them to a safe alternative route.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: If the block is long, install a high-visibility mid-block crosswalk with appropriate signage to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Enhanced Landscaping
interventions.description: Add low-level plantings or green infrastructure within the tree pits or along the fence line to soften the edge and improve the aesthetic quality of the walk.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming/Separation
interventions.description: Use temporary barriers to create a dedicated pedestrian lane in the roadway if a sidewalk tunnel is not feasible.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks to provide designated crossing points.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth surface for all users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Driveway Markings
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility paint or textured paving across the driveway entrance to alert drivers to the presence of the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters along the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk, potentially with a raised table or curb extensions, to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters along the right-hand sidewalk to improve the pedestrian experience and provide a buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a permanent, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk with a raised curb to provide safe pedestrian passage.

interventions.title: Temporary Protected Walkway
interventions.description: During construction, provide a temporary walkway with barriers to separate pedestrians from moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve safety and visibility during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Apply standard lane markings to organize traffic flow and potentially narrow the perceived travel lane to slow vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Tree Pit Grates
interventions.description: Ensure tree pits are flush with the sidewalk or protected with grates to maximize the usable walking surface and prevent tripping.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint to designate a safe crossing point.
